question: Compare monthly revenue by region over the last six complete months and identify unusual declines.
Show total monthly revenue for the last six complete months.
Which 10 products generated the most completed-order revenue across the full last six complete months? Return only product_id, product_name, and total_revenue, ordered by total_revenue descending.
Compare completed-order revenue by product category across the full last six complete months. Return one row per category with only category and total_revenue.

Compare actual completed-order revenue with the monthly revenue target for each region during the last six complete months. Return only month, region, revenue, revenue_target, target_variance, and target_achievement_pct. Calculate target_variance as revenue minus revenue_target and target_achievement_pct as revenue divided by revenue_target multiplied by 100.

Which regions were below their revenue target in the last complete month? Return only region, revenue, revenue_target, and target_variance. Calculate target_variance as revenue minus revenue_target, so a below-target result has a negative variance.
Compare completed-order revenue across customer segments over the full last six complete months. Return one row per segment with only segment and total_revenue.
Show month-over-month completed-order revenue growth for each customer segment during the last six complete months. Return only month, segment, revenue, previous_month_revenue, and growth_pct.

Show the monthly order cancellation rate for the last six complete months. Return only month, total_orders, cancelled_orders, and cancellation_rate_pct, in that exact column order. Return month as the first day of the month using PostgreSQL date type, not text. Calculate cancellation_rate_pct as cancelled_orders divided by total_orders multiplied by 100.
Which 10 customers generated the most revenue in the last six complete months?
Compare average completed-order value by region across the full last six complete months. Return one row per region with only region, completed_orders, total_revenue, and average_order_value.

What percentage of completed-order revenue did each product category contribute across the full last six complete months? Return one row per category with only category, total_revenue, and contribution_pct.
